name: Extrudr (FD3D GmbH)
summary: Austrian filament manufacturer based in Lauterach, Vorarlberg, trading as Extrudr under the legal entity FD3D GmbH. Produces in Austria with in-house laser-micrometer diameter QC, and is best known for GreenTEC and GreenTEC Pro - oil-free, bio-based engineering materials positioned as sustainable alternatives to petrochemical polymers.

product_lines.name: PLA NX2
product_lines.notes: 'New generation' PLA with improved mechanicals over commodity PLA; density 1.30 g/cm3, VICAT A 60 C

product_lines.name: PLA NX2 MATT
product_lines.notes: Matte variant of NX2

product_lines.name: PLA BASIC
product_lines.notes: Bio-based, EN13432-biodegradable PLA; density 1.24 g/cm3, VICAT A 55 C

product_lines.name: BioFusion
product_lines.notes: Proprietary bio-based copolymer with metallic gloss and raised impact resistance; density 1.25 g/cm3, VICAT A 75 C - not plain PLA and no generic equivalent exists

product_lines.name: GreenTEC
product_lines.notes: 100% renewable, biodegradable matte bio-engineering material; density 1.30 g/cm3, VICAT A 115 C - far above PLA and marketed as an oil-free ABS/PETG alternative, so no existing id fits

product_lines.name: GreenTEC Pro
product_lines.notes: Higher-performance bio-based grade, semi-matte; density 1.35 g/cm3, VICAT A 160 C / HDT-B 115 C; no existing id fits

product_lines.name: GreenTEC Pro CF
product_lines.notes: GreenTEC Pro matrix + 10% carbon fibre; density 1.20 g/cm3, VICAT A 165 C / HDT-B 115 C; no existing id fits

product_lines.name: FLAX
product_lines.notes: Bio-based matrix + mineral filler with a sandstone-like matte finish; density 1.45 g/cm3, VICAT A 48 C. No stone/mineral-filled id exists and the matrix is not confirmed to be PLA

product_lines.name: PEARL
product_lines.notes: Bio-based renewable translucent pearlescent grade; density 1.25 g/cm3, VICAT A 58 C / HDT-B 51 C - PLA-consistent

product_lines.name: WOOD
product_lines.notes: Lignin/biopolymer matrix + wood-fibre reinforcement; density 1.23 g/cm3, VICAT A 48 C. Matrix is described as lignin/biopolymer rather than explicitly PLA

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: Standard low-shrink PETG; density 1.29 g/cm3, VICAT A 78 C

product_lines.name: XPETG MATT

product_lines.name: XPETG CF
product_lines.notes: PETG + carbon fibre, UL94 V2; density 1.29 g/cm3, VICAT A 85 C / HDT-B 69 C

product_lines.name: PCTG
product_lines.notes: Modified copolyester, UL94 V2; density 1.21 g/cm3, VICAT A 88 C / HDT-B 76 C

product_lines.name: DuraPro ABS
product_lines.notes: Low-warp ABS; density 1.06 g/cm3, VICAT A 92 C / HDT-B 85 C

product_lines.name: DuraPro ASA
product_lines.notes: UV/weather-resistant ASA; density 1.05 g/cm3, VICAT A 96 C / HDT-B 96 C

product_lines.name: DuraPro ASA CF
product_lines.notes: ASA + carbon fibre; density 1.14 g/cm3, VICAT A 101 C / HDT-B 96 C

product_lines.name: DuraPro ASA GF
product_lines.notes: ASA + glass fibre; density 1.10 g/cm3, VICAT A 101 C / HDT-B 99 C. asa-gf is a provisional id

product_lines.name: DuraPro PA12
product_lines.notes: Polyamide 12, high notched impact and low moisture uptake; density 1.01 g/cm3, VICAT A 142 C

product_lines.name: DuraPro PA12 CF
product_lines.notes: PA12 + carbon fibre; density 1.03 g/cm3, VICAT A 145 C

product_lines.name: DuraPro PC/PBT
product_lines.notes: Polycarbonate/PBT alloy; density 1.20 g/cm3, VICAT A 126 C / HDT-B 85-110 C

product_lines.name: DuraPro PC/PBT CF
product_lines.notes: PC/PBT alloy + carbon fibre; density 1.01 g/cm3. No pc-pbt-cf id exists

product_lines.name: FLEX SEMISOFT
product_lines.notes: Polycaprolactone-polyester TPU, Shore 85A; density 1.18 g/cm3, elongation to 550%

product_lines.name: FLEX MEDIUM
product_lines.notes: Polycaprolactone-polyester TPU, Shore 98A; density 1.19 g/cm3, elongation to 470%. Above the 85A-95A band of the base tpu entry, no tpu-98a grade exists

product_lines.name: FLEX MEDIUM ESD
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A TPU with ESD-conductive additive (0.7-0.9 MOhm); density 1.20 g/cm3. petg-esd has no TPU counterpart

product_lines.name: FLEX HARD
product_lines.notes: Polycaprolactone-polyester TPU, Shore 58D against the 60D grade's nominal; density 1.20 g/cm3, elongation to 480%

product_lines.name: FLEX HARD CF
product_lines.notes: TPU + carbon fibre, Shore 70D, density 1.22 g/cm3, damping-oriented; tpu-gf is glass-filled, no tpu-cf id exists

additional_notes: No evidence of white-labelling for others or of reselling, so no oem_relationships are recorded; Extrudr does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md. Pricing roughly $24-38/kg per a third-party review aggregator, comparable to Fillamentum and colorFabb. Whether Extrudr sells build plates was not established - the site has an accessories section but no build-plate product was found - so makes_plates is left unset. Some third-party reviews report batch-to-batch diameter variability despite the company's QC claims. Whether all raw polymer feedstock is EU-sourced versus imported resin is unverified; manufacturing_countries reflects extrusion location.

provenance.conflicts: Company QC claims (laser micrometer, tight tolerance) versus third-party reports of batch-to-batch diameter variability are unreconciled. GreenTEC and BioFusion have no mapped filament type ids.
